evidence: BRIEF CLAUSE REFUTED (_MANDATORY #3), index.ts NOT restructured. The row title says the @cloudflare/sandbox chain 'fails under bun on macOS'; it fails under bun on EVERY platform -- reproduced on this Linux box byte-for-byte. GROUND TRUTH, verbatim, PR #14 eighth-run macOS worker leg (job 100991453440), log line 603, the ONLY module-resolution error in all 2242 lines, printed once inside ##[group]src/index.test.ts: "error: Cannot find package 'cloudflare:workers' from '/Users/runner/work/ezil-os/ezil-os/worker/node_modules/@cloudflare/sandbox/dist/sandbox-DKG3H156.js'". MECHANISM: five worker/src tests load ./index; four (route-auth, workspace-idle, workspace-flush-loop, desktop-release) register mock.module('cloudflare:workers') themselves; index.test.ts did not, and passed only because directory order put a registering file first (ext4; Windows alphabetical, desktop-release sorts before index). On APFS index.test.ts ran FIRST, threw, and bun served the same cached rejection to every later importer -- so the four correct files failed too: 205 red on macOS, 0 on Linux/Windows. Fix (a) from the brief is IMPOSSIBLE: route-auth.test.ts:356 loads ./index to run the real default.fetch route table (its stated purpose) and workspace-flush-loop.test.ts:231 pulls Sandbox.prototype, so no extraction removes the SDK from the test path; fix (c) is the repo's own documented pattern (workspace-idle.test.ts:39-46 describes this exact bug) and applies to the SDK's workerd builtin, not repo code. LANDED, 6 commits on task/M4, zero production files touched: index.test.ts (own stub + LF-normalising readWorkerSource() over all 38 source reads + a 4-test source pin), workspace-idle.test.ts (LF normalise), telemetry-container-tail.test.ts (3 tests gated with a measured cause), .github/workflows/ci.yml (both `if: runner.os == 'Linux'` gates removed; junit path made relative because bun-on-Windows and Git Bash do not agree on /tmp). The padded count sits INSIDE the meta line where the parser's head.trim() cannot reach, so CONTAINER_TELEMETRY_META_RE never matches and the parser degrades exactly as designed. Gated on the userland; shape-probed with the platform check forced false: 10 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail, reason printed. Linux unchanged at 13 pass / 0 fail.
